main_subject.detail: A minimal reward poster with large black headline text 'Thuong tang truong'. Supporting copy reads 'Khi tang them 50, 100 hoac 200 giao dich hop le so voi thang truoc(*)'. In the center stands a large glossy red U-point coin on top of a glowing red-orange podium block. The podium text reads 'den 1 Trieu U-Point'. Smaller floating U-coins orbit around it. The Techcombank logo appears at the top right, and the legal note at bottom right says '(*) Ap dung cho khach hang co duoi 300 giao dich hop le trong thang'.
